title: Example Vendor A vs Example Vendor B Buyer Evaluation
category: Customer success platforms (ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE: fictional vendors, fictional sources)

findings.key_finding: Example Vendor A is the stronger verified fit on Salesforce depth. Example Vendor B's 6-week implementation claim is contradicted by two customer accounts describing 4-6 month rollouts.
findings.key_unknown: Whether either vendor syncs custom Salesforce objects in both directions without a professional services engagement.
findings.next_question: Ask Example Vendor A to show a custom object syncing both ways, live, in a sandbox.

criteria.text: Bidirectional Salesforce sync, including custom objects
Built for a mixed high-touch and digital-led CS model

vendors.name: Example Vendor A
vendors.concern: Pricing and packaging are not public
vendors.summary: Documentation and customer accounts agree on standard-object sync in both directions. Custom-object support is documented but its services requirement is unclear.

vendors.name: Example Vendor B
vendors.summary: Strong for automated, one-to-many programs, which its reviews confirm. The fast-implementation claim did not hold up, which matters given your 90-day window.

claims.claim: Bidirectional Salesforce sync for standard objects
claims.evidence: Integration docs describe field mapping both ways; several customer reviews mention it working as described.
Documented, but the setup guide says custom objects are 'configured with your onboarding team'. No customer account found.
Trust page names the audit firm and offers the report under NDA.
SCIM is documented; the plan it belongs to is not stated anywhere public.
Two customer accounts describe 4-6 month rollouts for teams your size; no account of a 6-week rollout found.
Consistent theme in reviews from digital-led CS teams.
Integration exists; docs describe sync from Salesforce only, with writes back via a paid connector.

could_change: If Example Vendor A confirms custom-object sync without professional services, its fit on your first criterion moves from qualified to fully met.
If Example Vendor B provides two references your size that went live in under 90 days, the implementation concern largely falls away.
If SCIM is an add-on for either vendor, total cost and security review timing change.

unanswered.question: Does custom-object sync need a services engagement?
unanswered.why: It affects cost and your 90-day timeline.

unanswered.why: Losing health-score history resets your baselines.

demo_questions.listen_for: Whether it needs your onboarding team or a paid package.

Introduce us to two customers our size who went live in under 90 days.

demo_questions.question: Is writing back to Salesforce included, or is it the paid connector?
